title: China, ASEAN make progress on SCS pact but can’t finish talks this year

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — China and Southeast Asian countries have made progress on a South China Sea pact but won’t be able to conclude decades of negotiations this year as agreed, three regional diplomats said Wednesday.
